title: Site Investigation
description: We start below the surface, building a ground model from desk study and intrusive site work before the frame is fixed.

title: Concept & Collaboration
description: Ground model, structural concept and budget move together, with the client and wider design team involved early and often.

title: Value Engineering
description: We test options against cost, programme and buildability, matching the foundation solution to the structure it carries.

title: Design Delivery
description: Coordinated drawings and analysis carry the scheme from concept to completion, with support on site through construction.
